image_description: A close-up view of an ornate, antique wooden bookcase featuring a mix of open shelving and glass-paned cabinet doors. The wood is dark and polished with intricate carvings on the upper frame. The shelves are densely packed with books of varying sizes and colors. The perspective is slightly angled, showing the depth of the shelves.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular furniture piece of considerable height, notably taller than wide.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object is clearly a tall piece of furniture extending beyond the top of the frame, consistent with a bookcase silhouette.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tall rectangular frame with horizontal divisions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Horizontal shelf lines are clearly visible dividing the vertical space.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Bilateral symmetry with open front displaying books and objects.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the design intent may be symmetrical, the image shows an asymmetrical composition due to the angle and the specific configuration (glass doors on left, open shelves on right). It is not strictly bilaterally symmetrical in this view.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Multiple horizontal shelves spaced evenly from top to bottom.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: At least 4-5 distinct shelf levels are visible, holding books.
Adjustability is an internal mechanical feature not visually verifiable from the exterior image.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Some models have glass doors on upper section.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The left section of the bookcase clearly features glass-paned doors with wooden mullions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Constructed from wood particleboard or metal with finished surface stained painted or laminated.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture, grain, and color indicate stained wood construction.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Front open displaying books and objects on each shelf.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Books are clearly visible on the shelves, both behind the glass and in the open section.
Intricate carved details are visible at the top, and the wood has a polished finish.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the book spines is illegible and appears as blurred, nonsensical patterns rather than distinct characters, a common AI artifact in detailed text rendering.

The wooden mullions within the glass doors on the left exhibit slight warping and inconsistent thickness. Some lines do not align perfectly with the frame edges, suggesting minor geometric instability.

artifact_observations.location: Books on the right-hand open shelves
artifact_observations.reasoning: Some book spines appear to merge slightly into one another or lack clear separation boundaries, creating a 'melted' look in the dense packing.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bookcase and not a generic shelf or cabinet.
To verify the 3D consistency of the shelves and the depth of the cabinet, ensuring no spatial bleeding between books and back panels.
To check for clean boundaries between the glass panes and wooden frames, detecting any fusion or edge bleeding.
To assess the overall realism and identify any subtle texture inconsistencies in the wood grain or book spines.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on book spines
Geometric straightness and alignment of door mullions
Consistency of wood grain texture across carved and flat surfaces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the book spines; AI often fails to render coherent text, resulting in gibberish that looks like text from a distance. Also, inspect the glass door frames for any warping or non-Euclidean geometry. The classifier should easily identify this as a bookcase, but the structural integrity of the fine details (mullions, book edges) is the primary failure mode risk.
